objective.text: Use the intended guard explicitly when multiple authentication contexts exist.

difficulty.rationale: Read the identity associated with the intended guard rather than the default one.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: The default web guard contains customer 7; the admin guard contains administrator 99. An admin-only service must read the administrator identity without changing the default guard globally. Which call is appropriate?

options.rationale: The user accessor is not the documented guard selector; passing a guard name there does not replace guard("admin").
options.misconception: The user accessor is not the documented guard selector; passing a guard name there does not replace guard("admin").

options.rationale: A submitted ID is not the authenticated identity maintained by the admin guard.
options.misconception: A submitted ID is not the authenticated identity maintained by the admin guard.

options.rationale: Selecting the guard explicitly reads its identity while leaving the configured default guard unchanged.
This reads the default web guard and therefore returns customer 7.
options.misconception: This reads the default web guard and therefore returns customer 7.
